title: Walkup presenter cash advance & receipt log
content:
Purpose:
Quick scratchpad for handling walk-up presenters who need same-day cash advances and receipt capture at conferences/meetups. Use this when the normal pre-pay flow fails and we need a fast, auditable handoff.

Topline rules (notes to self):
- Max cash advance per walkup presenter: $150 (unless pre-approved by finance lead).
- Always get a photo of government ID and the presenter’s venue badge before disbursing.
- Use petty-cash envelope (blue) and log envelope ID on the mobile form.
- If presenter asks for vendor reimbursement (e.g., taxi or food), prefer card payment through company card; cash only if card unavailable.

Immediate checklist (on arrival):
- [ ] Confirm presenter name + talk slot with stage manager.
- [ ] Check if advance already requested (quick search in #events-ops).
- [ ] Photo ID + badge captured (snap to phone, upload to EVENTS channel thread).
- [ ] Fill out Walkup Advance form (paper or Google Forms link below).
- [ ] Get signature on petty-cash receipt and write envelope ID.
- [ ] Provide clear note: receipts required within 72 hours or amount will be clawed back.

Vendor & contact quicklist (local) - keep short/fast:
- Hotel front desk (cash till): +1 415-555-0123 (Hilton Embarcadero front desk)
- Onsite catering manager (for complimentary speaker snack): +1 415-555-0456 (Maria G.)
- Taxis / local drivers (preferred): RideShare Dispatch +1 415-555-0789 (use company code REDWOOD-EVT)
- Nearby ATM (fast): 100 Main St — approx 3 min from venue (fee note: up to $3.50)

Receipt intake / photo standards (to avoid rejection):
- Include total, date, merchant name. If card swipe only shows last 4 digits, attach merchant receipt.
- For food, indicate who was paid for (presenter name) in a short note on the receipt photo.
- For taxis, request printed receipt with route or take a screenshot of the app ride showing pick-up/drop-off and fare.
- If using cash advance for incidentals (e.g., cable adaptor), get itemized receipt, otherwise annotate purpose and approximate unit price.

Sample quick tally (hand-written on envelope + logged in spreadsheet later):
- Cash advanced: $120
- Receipts returned: 2 items (taxi $24.50, lunch $18.20)
- Outstanding receipts: $77.30 (note: needs itemized receipts or attach declaration)

Reimbursement notes for finance upload: 
- Use expense category: "Walkup Presenter Advance" (project code EVENTS-2025)
- Attach photos: ID, badge, envelope photo, all receipts, signed form
- Submit via Concur/Google Sheet within 72 hours; CC events-ops@redwood.ai

Edge cases + troubleshooting (quick fyi):
- Presenter refuses photo ID: escalate to on-site security and do not disburse cash.
- Lost receipts: have presenter fill a Lost Receipt Declaration (short free-form) and attach a manager approval scan. Finance may deny partial amounts.
- Currency issues (international presenters): avoid cash advance in foreign currency unless absolutely necessary — prefer to reimburse on card in USD and claim FX. If cash required, get AMEX travel desk approval.

Open questions / follow-ups (to resolve post-event):
- Confirm whether finance will accept the current low-resolution phone photos or if a scanned PDF is required for the ledger.
- Add one-line flow to the Walkup Playbook about how to tag the event code in expense tool automatically.
- Can we pre-load a single reserve company card with $500 and hand it to AM for speaker purchases instead of repeated cash advances? Action: ask Samir to raise with ops.

Quick links (for mobile):
- Walkup Advance Form (mobile): https://forms.gle/walkup-advance
- Events Petty Cash Log (sheet): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/PETTY-CASH-2025
- Finance policy excerpt (relevant): https://confluence.company/finance/expense-policy#walkup

Notes to self (style): keep entries extremely terse; prefer timestamps and initials on the envelope log. When back at the hotel, transcribe to the master petty-cash sheet and attach photos.

Timestamped example entry (real style):
2025-01-10 14:12 - Mina A. - Walkup advance $120 to J. Kaur (Badge #A37). ID pic uploaded to #events-ops thread. Envelope E-142. Receipts returned 01/12: taxi $24.50, lunch $18.20. Outstanding $77.30 -> emailed JIRA EV-3124 to follow.

Unresolved: should we increase default cap to $200 for late-night presenters? Note for retrospective.

End of scratchpad.
